title: Week 11 official injury report is not published at read time
detail: The URL https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/reg11 was requested; the fetch tool reported the final URL as .../reg10 and the title as Week 10. No Week 11 player row can be read. Do not publish any Week 11 availability value from this page. Retry on the publication days.

title: Official pages print the Rams as LAR and as LA
detail: The Week 11 schedule bye block prints LARLos Angeles Rams. The official standings club-logo path uses LA for the same club. Arizona is AZ on both pages. Any join by code must map LAR to LA and must not use ARI. This is the same class of defect logged as CU-F03 by session 35a1feb2 on its own results feed.

detail: The Sunday Night Football section shows a 'Mexico City 2026' logo directly above Vikings at 49ers (8:20 PM, NBC). The printed game line gives no venue. Whether this game is in Mexico City is NOT confirmed. The venue is left blank.

detail: Game lines print times like '8:15 PM' with no zone. The schedule's flexible-scheduling note refers to ET, but the zone is not stated on each game line. The desk stores the printed time only and does not convert it.
